replace: /// custom (lclite "low-detail" mod): RuneLite's Low Detail as a panel switch
/// instead of a second webclient (?lowmem=1). Read ONCE, during construction,
/// because Pix3D.lowMem decides the texture + texel-pool layout at unpack time
/// (half-size textures, lowMem raster path) — flipping it live would leave
/// already-uploaded textures in the other layout, so the per-frame hook in
/// Client.lowMem is NOT touched: that flag is the low-memory CLIENT launch mode
/// (no music/sounds, lowMemory reported to the server), not a graphics setting.
/// custom (lclite "low-detail" mod): the live half of the switch — the panel
/// toggle has to change the world without a reload. World.lowMem is read per
/// ground triangle (textured ground falls back to its flat average colour) and
/// the scene builder re-derives ClientBuild.lowMem from it on every build
/// (ground decorations + off-level geometry), so this one assignment is what
/// makes the switch work in game. Client.lowMem (launch mode) is honoured so a
/// ?lowmem=1 session is never downgraded by us.
